arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM transactions WHERE date >= '2019-02-01' AND date < '2019-03-01'
arguments.explanation: This counts every transaction dated in February 2019.
assumptions: February 2019 covers 2019-02-01 00:00:00 up to, but not including, 2019-03-01.
All transactions are counted, whether or not they have a fraud label and whatever their amount (negative amounts and errored transactions included).
